faqLeft.q: What engine does the Mercedes Viano 3.0 CDI use?
faqLeft.a: It uses the OM642 3.0‑litre V6 diesel across its entire production run (2003-2014, W639).

faqLeft.q: How much does a Mercedes Viano 3.0 CDI engine rebuild cost?
faqLeft.a: Rebuilds start from £2,800. Exact price depends on condition and parts required - submit your reg for a fixed‑price quote.

faqLeft.q: Which engine code is fitted to my Viano 3.0 CDI?
faqLeft.a: All Viano 3.0 CDI models have the OM642. Enter your registration on this page and we’ll confirm your exact spec before you’re quoted anything.

faqLeft.q: Do you rebuild OM642 Viano 3.0 CDI engines?
faqLeft.a: Yes. We replace worn swirl flaps, injector seals and the timing chain as standard on every OM642 rebuild.

faqRight.q: Do you supply used Viano 3.0 CDI engines?
faqRight.a: Yes, in some cases a matched low‑mileage used engine is the right option. Our team will advise honestly once we’ve matched your registration and understood your situation.

faqRight.q: Can you recover my Viano 3.0 CDI if the engine has failed?
faqRight.a: Yes - nationwide recovery is available from £70, and most vehicles are collected within a few hours of booking.

faqRight.q: How long does a Viano 3.0 CDI engine rebuild take?
faqRight.a: Most rebuilds are completed within 3‑5 working days from the time your van arrives at our workshop.

faqRight.q: Is rebuilding better than fitting a used engine?
faqRight.a: For most Viano 3.0 CDI owners, yes. A rebuild removes the compatibility risk that comes with an unknown used unit’s history, and comes with a 12‑month unlimited‑mileage warranty - often longer and more comprehensive than what a used engine supplier offers.

form.guarantee: Most quotes returned within 30 minutes during working hours.
